<!-- uv-active-slice: legacy-music-action-envelope-retirement -->
<!-- uv-next-slice: legacy-music-action-envelope-retirement -->

## Goal

Retire the duplicate Product Orchestrator mutation/action envelope for legacy `music_video` projects while preserving the temporary read-only Music workflow/readiness projection, the legacy Music UI, direct Music domain APIs/capability execution and all project-owned Music state.

## Changes

The five Music Product Workflow mutation actions (`save_music_map`, `save_music_direction`, `save_music_assembly`, `render_music_master`, `review_music_master`) and Music-specific backend dispatch glue are retired. `GET /api/uv/projects/{id}/workflow` remains temporary read compatibility.

The specialized Music clients retain their UI-facing functions but now use the established direct authorities:

- Music Map → `/music-map/commands`;
- Music Director → `/music-direction/commands`;
- Music Assembly → `/music-assembly/commands`;
- master render → `video.render_music_video` capability execution with `local_free_first`;
- final Review → `/music-video-review`.

Browser acceptance requires zero Music POSTs to `/workflow/actions/` and positively observes all five direct mutation paths while preserving the rendered artifact, approved Review and ready workflow state.

## Review findings and repairs

Superseded review head `cd5bea656ef2e7612bda46f9c324d933103860ae` exposed the first confirmed P2: direct `video.render_music_video` had dropped the old Product Workflow `rhythm_aligned` prerequisite. PR #95 returned to Draft and the canonical direct capability was repaired to require `MusicDirectionStore.rhythm_audit(project_id).summary.all_aligned == true` before source probing or FFmpeg/FFprobe execution. A focused real-media regression proves a valid 500,000 µs misalignment fails with HTTP 422 before media execution and creates no render artifact. Material head `cb9852c6ee8b59020d00c0adc8c1b309705cced2` passed exact-head CI #4888 5/5.

Superseded review head `9c55b852175dd882ccde85c3e39e2395d9af04f1` then exposed a second confirmed P2: `rhythm_audit()` independently reloads current Direction/Map, while the adapter previously consumed only `summary.all_aligned`. A concurrent aligned D2 could therefore authorize rendering an older A1/D1 assembly.

PR #95 returned to Draft again. Draft context head `23d5a54614fa1e7781ac80ee1ffb5d720139cb6d` passed `development-context` before material repair. The direct capability now fails closed unless the rhythm audit's Direction revision equals both the loaded Direction revision and the Assembly-bound Direction revision, and the audit Map revision equals the loaded Music Map revision. The focused race regression injects an apparently aligned audit from a different Direction revision and requires HTTP 422 before any FFmpeg/FFprobe runner invocation and without a render artifact.

No long-running render lock, Music UI component, new endpoint, replacement planner or Product Workflow mutation action was introduced. Photo Composer, Visualizer, broader Product Orchestrator, Stage8 and other directions remain out of scope.

## Verification

Base remains lifecycle-closed `main` `57bbbec41b2e82e556d620efb21f3b6cdf2a5a47` after accepted execution-plan retirement PR #93 and closure PR #94.

Final material head `1ccf2e4cf07231064c0ab10c16dd3e0eeafd4116` passed CI #4897 with all five permanent jobs SUCCESS. After this PR body was synchronized to the second-P2 repair evidence, PR-event CI #4899 on the same material bytes also passed all five permanent jobs SUCCESS, including Stage 4A real-media and Stage 4C + Stage 5 browser user-outcome suites on Ubuntu and Windows.

Current frozen review HEAD is `4d18e1fca2c9199bed41014385a4e317380c47a8`. Its only delta from the 5/5 material head is the three project-context files changing lifecycle from Draft to review and recording the accepted repair evidence. PR #95 is Ready. Final review acceptance requires one exact-head Ready CI run with all five permanent jobs SUCCESS on `4d18e1fca2c9199bed41014385a4e317380c47a8` with this current PR metadata.

## Architecture impact

This remains a bounded D-070 authority reduction. Product Workflow is temporary read-only compatibility state for the legacy Music page; Music mutations are owned by established Music domain APIs and Capability authority. The repaired direct render boundary preserves the retired Product Workflow's rhythm prerequisite while binding that prerequisite to the exact Assembly/Direction/Map revision identity being rendered.

Execution-plan retirement is already accepted through PR #93/#94. Internal Recipe Registry, broader Product Orchestrator, Stage8 and persisted-project compatibility remain separately scheduled work.

## Known limitations

This slice does not migrate the whole legacy Music page to modern Studio, retire Product Orchestrator GET/read state, remove Stage8, alter other directions, change Music storage/domain services, or complete the `micro_drama` golden vertical.

## Next task

Require exact frozen review HEAD `4d18e1fca2c9199bed41014385a4e317380c47a8` to pass all five permanent jobs in a Ready pull_request run with this current metadata. Then reply to and resolve both confirmed P2 threads with exact repair/CI evidence, verify zero unresolved threads and unchanged BASE/HEAD, and obtain a new genuinely fresh ordinary-ChatGPT semantic review using `.agents/skills/code-review/SKILL.md` v1.0. Merge only on CURRENT/PASS with zero findings and no unresolved review threads; after merge complete the mandatory separate D-038 lifecycle closure.

**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Preserve the rhythm gate on direct renders**

When the current Music Director has unaligned cuts, this direct capability request now reaches `render_music_video_state`, which validates revisions and media but never runs `rhythm_audit`; the UI's render button is also enabled for every saved assembly. Previously, `render_music_master` was disabled unless `rhythm_aligned` was true, so this migration allows an unusable master artifact to consume render time before the final review rejects approval. Restore this prerequisite at the canonical direct execution boundary so frontend behavior and backend acceptance remain compatible.

review_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Bind the rhythm audit to the assembly revision**

When another request saves a new Music Director after the assembly and `direction` are validated but before this call, `rhythm_audit()` reloads the new direction/map rather than auditing the revision bound to the loaded assembly. An unaligned D1/A1 can therefore pass if the concurrent D2 is aligned, after which FFmpeg renders the stale, unaligned assembly and creates an artifact that final review cannot accept. Fresh evidence beyond the earlier rhythm-gate report is that the repaired gate ignores the audit's revision fields and these reads share no snapshot lock; compare the audit revision with the loaded direction/assembly or audit them under one consistent snapshot before rendering.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
